-addDecoys.description: set to true predicts reversed decoys as normal JChronologer entries and writes them to the DLIB decoy table (roughly doubling prediction time).

-generateProteinEntrapments.description: true generates one shuffled protein-level entrapment accession per target protein using -entrapmentSeed for reproducibility.

notes: Fixed TMT requires -ptmProteinNTermAcetyl off -ptmPyroGluQ off to avoid terminal-site conflicts.
Peptide length is fixed at 7-31 residues for JChronologer library prediction.
Charge states are selected from Electrician probabilities (>1%), then filtered by charge range and m/z range.
JChronologer always runs Sculptor CCS/IMS prediction and stores it in the library IonMobility column.

scribe.summary: Scribe is a library search engine for DDA data. You should prefix your arguments with a high memory setting, e.g. "-Xmx8g" for 8gb
scribe.title: Scribe Help

flag_patterns.-ptm*: named Chronologer PTM state (off|var|fix); do not mix with -fixed/-variable

-defaultCharge.description: default charge used for FASTA prediction NCE adjustment

-fixed.description: fixed site masses, for example C=57.0214635; use -fixed - for none

-maxMissedCleavage.description: maximum FASTA missed cleavages; -1 allows any number

-mzIdentML.description: write mzIdentML 1.2.0 and converted adjusted mzML output (DDA mode only)

-nce.description: normalized collision energy for FASTA prediction

-predictionCache.description: directory for shared FASTA prediction cache

-requireVariableMods.description: require at least one variable modification

-scribeTwoAstralScoringFeatures.description: emit non-zero experimental Astral scoring features

-scribeTwoEffectiveIonCountFloor.description: minimum effective ion count used by the ion-count-calibrated X!Tandem feature

-scribeTwoRelativeIntensityMinIonCount.description: minimum top predicted fragment ions used for relative-intensity scoring

-scribeTwoRelativeIntensityThreshold.description: fraction of the predicted base fragment intensity used for relative-intensity scoring

-scribeTwoXCorrCacheSize.description: bounded LRU cache size for ScribeTwo theoretical XCorr calculators

-searchType.description: search type: auto, dia, dda_chimeric, or dda

-variable.description: variable site masses, for example S=79.966331,T=79.966331; use -variable - for none

notes: Fixed TMT requires -ptmProteinNTermAcetyl off -ptmPyroGluQ off to avoid terminal-site conflicts.
